sentences.en: Buck was a big dog, and he lived on a farm in the Santa Clara Valley.

sentences.en: "Now you know me," the man said, "and I know you."

sentences.en: The man gave him food and water, and Buck ate and drank.

sentences.en: Other dogs came in boxes, and Buck saw the same men hit them with the same club.

sentences.chapter: The Law of Club and Fang

sentences.en: "A dog must never fall down," Buck learned, "for the other dogs will kill him."

sentences.en: A man laughed, and Buck did not like the sound.

sentences.en: That night he did not sleep.

sentences.en: "We must go north tonight," Perrault said, "for the letters are waiting."

sentences.en: By the sled there were two other dogs.

sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o fera:v un:o bon:a chien:n de:o traîneau:n ,:o »:o dit:v Pete:o .:o

sentences.en: "He will stay with me," Thornton said, "and he will not go with any other man."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o restera:v avec:o moi:o ,:o dit:v Thornton:o ,:o et:o il:o ne:o suivra:v personne:o d':o autre:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Buck had loved Judge Miller, but this was a greater love.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o avait:v aimé:v le:o juge:n Miller:o ,:o mais:o il:o connaissait:v à:o présent:n un:o amour:n plus:a grand:a encore:a .:o

sentences.en: Thornton had saved his life, and he was the best master Buck had ever known.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o lui:o avait:v sauvé:v la:o vie:n ,:o et:o c':o était:v le:o meilleur:a maître:n que:o Buck:o eût:v jamais:a connu:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck lay at his feet all day and watched his face.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o passait:v ses:o journées:n couché:a à:o ses:o pieds:n ,:o les:o yeux:n fixés:a sur:o son:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: When Thornton went away, Buck followed him, and when he came back, Buck was there.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o Thornton:o s':o éloignait:v ,:o Buck:o le:o suivait:v ,:o et:o quand:o il:o revenait:v ,:o Buck:o était:v là:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck did not leave the camp, for he did not want to lose his master.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o ne:o quittait:v pas:o le:o campement:n ,:o de:o peur:n de:o perdre:v son:o maître:n .:o

sentences.en: He remembered Perrault and Francois, and he remembered the mail man.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o souvenait:v de:o Perrault:o et:o de:o François:o ,:o et:o aussi:a de:o l':o homme:n du:o courrier:n .:o

sentences.en: But Thornton was different, and Buck was afraid that Thornton would go away.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o Thornton:o n':o était:v pas:o comme:o eux:o ,:o et:o Buck:o craignait:v qu':o il:o ne:o s':o en:o aille:v à:o son:o tour:n .:o

sentences.en: At night Buck lay by the fire, and he did not dream of the hairy man.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n ,:o Buck:o se:o couchait:v près:a du:o feu:n ,:o et:o il:o ne:o rêvait:v plus:o de:o l':o homme:n velu:a .:o

sentences.en: In the spring Thornton and his partners went to Dawson, and Buck went with them.
sentences.tgt: Au:o printemps:n ,:o Thornton:o et:o ses:o associés:n se:o rendirent:v à:o Dawson:o ,:o et:o Buck:o les:o accompagna:v .:o

sentences.en: One night Thornton sat in a house where many men drank and talked, and Buck lay at his feet.
sentences.tgt: Un:o soir:n ,:o Thornton:o était:v assis:a dans:o une:o taverne:n pleine:a d':o hommes:n qui:o buvaient:v et:o bavardaient:v ,:o Buck:o couché:a à:o ses:o pieds:n .:o

sentences.en: A man named Burton stood near the fire, and he was angry with another man.
sentences.tgt: Un:o homme:n nommé:a Burton:o se:o tenait:v près:a du:o feu:n ,:o en:o colère:n contre:o un:o autre:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "You are a fool," Burton said, and he hit the other man in the face.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o es:v un:o imbécile:n ,:o »:o dit:v Burton:o ,:o et:o il:o frappa:v l':o autre:o au:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton stood up and said that Burton must stop.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o se:o leva:v et:o dit:v à:o Burton:o d':o arrêter:v .:o

sentences.en: "You must not hit him," Thornton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ne:o le:o frappez:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: Burton turned and hit Thornton, and Thornton fell down on the floor.
sentences.tgt: Burton:o se:o retourna:v et:o frappa:v Thornton:o ,:o qui:o s':o écroula:v sur:o le:o plancher:n .:o

sentences.en: The men shouted, and no one moved, for they were afraid of Burton.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n crièrent:v ,:o mais:o personne:o ne:o bougea:v ,:o car:o tous:o craignaient:v Burton:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck saw his master on the floor, and he jumped at Burton's throat.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o vit:v son:o maître:n à:o terre:n et:o sauta:v à:o la:o gorge:n de:o Burton:o .:o

sentences.en: Burton put up his arm, but Buck's teeth were in it, and blood came.
sentences.tgt: Burton:o leva:v le:o bras:n ,:o mais:o les:o crocs:n de:o Buck:o s':o y:o enfoncèrent:v ,:o et:o le:o sang:n jaillit:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck jumped again, and this time he bit Burton's neck.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o bondit:v de:o nouveau:a ,:o et:o cette:o fois:n il:o mordit:v Burton:o au:o cou:n .:o

sentences.en: The men pulled Buck away, and Burton fell down on the floor.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n tirèrent:v Buck:o en:o arrière:n ,:o et:o Burton:o s':o effondra:v sur:o le:o plancher:n .:o

sentences.en: A doctor came and looked at Burton, and Burton lived.
sentences.tgt: Un:o médecin:n vint:v examiner:v Burton:o ,:o qui:o survécut:v .:o

sentences.en: The men talked about Buck all that night, and they were not angry with him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n parlèrent:v de:o Buck:o toute:o la:o nuit:n ,:o sans:o lui:o en:o vouloir:v le:o moins:a du:o monde:n .:o

sentences.en: "That dog did right," they said, "for he saved his master."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o chien:n a:v eu:v raison:n ,:o disaient:v -ils:o ,:o il:o a:v sauvé:v son:o maître:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Everyone in Dawson knew about Buck after that night.
sentences.tgt: Après:o cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o tout:o Dawson:o connaissait:v Buck:o .:o

sentences.en: In the summer Thornton and his partners took a boat down a fast river.
sentences.tgt: L':o été:n venu:a ,:o Thornton:o et:o ses:o associés:n descendirent:v en:o barque:n une:o rivière:n rapide:a .:o

sentences.en: Hans and Pete stood on the bank with a rope, and Thornton stood in the boat with a pole.
sentences.tgt: Hans:o et:o Pete:o tenaient:v une:o corde:n depuis:o la:o berge:n ,:o tandis:o que:o Thornton:o ,:o debout:a dans:o la:o barque:n ,:o maniait:v une:o perche:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran along the bank, and he watched Thornton all the time.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o courait:v le:o long:n de:o la:o berge:n ,:o sans:o quitter:v Thornton:o des:o yeux:n .:o

sentences.en: The river was fast, and the water went over the rocks with a great noise.
sentences.tgt: Le:o courant:n était:v rapide:a ,:o et:o l':o eau:n se:o ruait:v sur:o les:o rochers:n dans:o un:o grand:a fracas:n .:o

sentences.en: The boat turned in the water, and Thornton fell out of it.
sentences.tgt: La:o barque:n pivota:v dans:o le:o courant:n ,:o et:o Thornton:o passa:v par-dessus:o bord:n .:o

sentences.en: The river took him, and he could not stand up.
sentences.tgt: Le:o courant:n l':o emporta:v ,:o et:o il:o ne:o put:v reprendre:v pied:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck did not wait, and he jumped into the river and swam to his master.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o n':o attendit:v pas:o ::o il:o sauta:v dans:o la:o rivière:n et:o nagea:v vers:o son:o maître:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton took Buck by the neck, and Buck swam to the bank with him.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o agrippa:v Buck:o par:o le:o cou:n ,:o et:o Buck:o nagea:v vers:o la:o berge:n en:o le:o remorquant:v .:o

sentences.en: Hans and Pete pulled the rope, and they pulled Thornton and Buck to the bank.
sentences.tgt: Hans:o et:o Pete:o halèrent:v la:o corde:n et:o ramenèrent:v Thornton:o et:o Buck:o jusqu':o à:o la:o berge:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton lay on the ground, and he could not speak for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o resta:v étendu:a sur:o le:o sol:n ,:o longtemps:a incapable:a de:o parler:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck lay beside him and put his head on Thornton's hand.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o coucha:v à:o côté:n de:o lui:o et:o posa:v la:o tête:n sur:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: "You are a good dog, Buck," Thornton said at last.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o es:v un:o bon:a chien:n ,:o Buck:o ,:o »:o dit:v enfin:a Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: "You saved my life, and I will not forget it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o m':o as:v sauvé:v la:o vie:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o l':o oublierai:v pas:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Thornton and his partners needed money, for they wanted to go far into the north to look for gold.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o et:o ses:o associés:n avaient:v besoin:n d':o argent:n ,:o car:o ils:o voulaient:v s':o enfoncer:v loin:a dans:o le:o Nord:n à:o la:o recherche:n d':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: One day in Dawson a man named Matthewson talked about his dog.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o à:o Dawson:o ,:o un:o homme:n nommé:a Matthewson:o vantait:v les:o mérites:n de:o son:o chien:n .:o

sentences.en: "My dog can pull a sled with 1000 pounds on it," Matthewson said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mon:o chien:n peut:v tirer:v un:o traîneau:n chargé:a de:o mille:o livres:n ,:o »:o affirma:v Matthewson:o .:o

sentences.en: "Buck can pull it too," Thornton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Buck:o peut:v en:o faire:v autant:a ,:o »:o dit:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Can Buck start a sled with 1000 pounds on it?" Matthewson asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Buck:o peut:v -il:o arracher:v un:o traîneau:n chargé:a de:o mille:o livres:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Matthewson:o .:o

sentences.en: "Can he walk 100 yards with it?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Et:o le:o traîner:v sur:o cent:o yards:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "He can," Thornton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o le:o peut:v ,:o »:o dit:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Then I will bet you 1000 dollars that he cannot," Matthewson said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Alors:a je:o vous:o parie:v mille:o dollars:n qu':o il:o n':o y:o arrivera:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Matthewson:o .:o

sentences.en: Thornton did not have 1000 dollars, and he did not know what to say.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o n':o avait:v pas:o mille:o dollars:n ,:o et:o il:o ne:o sut:v que:o répondre:v .:o

sentences.en: Thornton asked a friend, and the friend gave him the money.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o s':o adressa:v à:o un:o ami:n ,:o qui:o lui:o avança:v la:o somme:n .:o

sentences.en: Many men came to see the sled, and they bet on the other dog.
sentences.tgt: Beaucoup:a d':o hommes:n vinrent:v voir:v le:o traîneau:n ,:o et:o ils:o misèrent:v sur:o l':o autre:a chien:n .:o

sentences.en: The sled was heavy, and the ice held it to the ground.
sentences.tgt: Le:o traîneau:n était:v lourd:a ,:o et:o la:o glace:n le:o soudait:v au:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: "That dog cannot move it," a man said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o chien:n ne:o le:o bougera:v jamais:o ,:o »:o dit:v un:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "He can," said another man.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o si:a ,:o il:o le:o peut:v ,:o »:o dit:v un:o autre:o .:o

sentences.en: Thornton stood beside Buck and took his head in his hands.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o se:o plaça:v à:o côté:n de:o Buck:o et:o lui:o prit:v la:o tête:n entre:o ses:o mains:n .:o

sentences.en: "Do it for me, Buck," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Fais:v -le:o pour:o moi:o ,:o Buck:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "Do it for me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Fais:v -le:o pour:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Buck licked his hand and looked at his master's face.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o lui:o lécha:v la:o main:n et:o leva:v les:o yeux:n vers:o le:o visage:n de:o son:o maître:n .:o

sentences.en: Then he stood up and went to the sled.
sentences.tgt: Puis:a il:o se:o leva:v et:o alla:v se:o placer:v devant:o le:o traîneau:n .:o

sentences.en: "Now, Buck," Thornton shouted.
sentences.tgt: «:o Allez:v ,:o Buck:o !:o »:o cria:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Pull!"
sentences.tgt: «:o Tire:v !:o »:o

sentences.en: Buck pulled as hard as he could, and the sled moved a little.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o tira:v de:o toutes:o ses:o forces:n ,:o et:o le:o traîneau:n bougea:v légèrement:a .:o

sentences.en: The ice under the sled broke, and the sled began to move.
sentences.tgt: La:o glace:n céda:v sous:o le:o traîneau:n ,:o qui:o se:o mit:v en:o marche:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck pulled again, and he pulled the sled along the street.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o tira:v de:o nouveau:a et:o entraîna:v le:o traîneau:n le:o long:n de:o la:o rue:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck pulled the sled for 100 yards, and there he stopped.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o tira:v le:o traîneau:n sur:o cent:o yards:n ,:o et:o là:a ,:o il:o s':o arrêta:v .:o

sentences.en: The men shouted, and some of them cried.
sentences.tgt: Une:o clameur:n s':o éleva:v ,:o et:o certains:o hommes:n pleuraient:v .:o

sentences.en: Thornton put his arms around Buck and held him.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o jeta:v les:o bras:n autour:o du:o cou:n de:o Buck:o et:o le:o serra:v contre:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: He had won 1000 dollars, and Buck had won it for him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o avait:v gagné:v mille:o dollars:n ,:o et:o c':o était:v Buck:o qui:o les:o lui:o avait:v gagnés:v .:o

sentences.en: Thornton paid his friend the money, and then he and his partners had money for the long trip.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o rendit:v l':o argent:n à:o son:o ami:n ,:o et:o ses:o associés:n et:o lui:o eurent:v de:o quoi:o payer:v le:o long:a voyage:n .:o

sentences.en: That night he gave Buck the best meat in all of Dawson.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o soir-là:n ,:o il:o offrit:v à:o Buck:o la:o meilleure:a viande:n de:o tout:o Dawson:o .:o

sentences.en: Thornton and his partners wanted to find a lost cabin in the east, and men said that there was much gold near it.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o et:o ses:o associés:n voulaient:v retrouver:v une:o cabane:n perdue:a dans:o l':o Est:n ,:o près:a de:o laquelle:o ,:o disait:v -on:o ,:o l':o or:n abondait:v .:o

sentences.en: No man had found the cabin, but many men had looked for it.
sentences.tgt: Personne:o n':o avait:v jamais:o trouvé:v la:o cabane:n ,:o mais:o beaucoup:a l':o avaient:v cherchée:v .:o

sentences.en: Thornton took Pete and Hans, and they went east with Buck and six other dogs.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o emmena:v Pete:o et:o Hans:o ,:o et:o ils:o partirent:v vers:o l':o Est:n avec:o Buck:o et:o six:o autres:a chiens:n .:o

sentences.en: They had food for many days, and they were not afraid.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o emportaient:v des:o vivres:n pour:o bien:a des:o jours:n et:o ne:o craignaient:v rien:o .:o

sentences.en: They went through forests and over rivers, and they did not stop.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o traversèrent:v des:o forêts:n ,:o franchirent:v des:o rivières:n ,:o sans:o jamais:o s':o arrêter:v .:o

sentences.en: When they had no food, they killed animals, and they ate fish from the water.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o les:o vivres:n venaient:v à:o manquer:v ,:o ils:o tuaient:v du:o gibier:n et:o pêchaient:v du:o poisson:n .:o

sentences.en: The days were long, and the nights were short, for it was summer.
sentences.tgt: Les:o jours:n étaient:v longs:a et:o les:o nuits:n courtes:a ,:o car:o c':o était:v l':o été:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck pulled the sled, and he was strong and glad.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o tirait:v le:o traîneau:n ,:o plein:a de:o force:n et:o de:o joie:n .:o

sentences.en: At last they came to a wide valley, and there was gold in the ground.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a ,:o ils:o arrivèrent:v dans:o une:o large:a vallée:n où:o la:o terre:n recelait:v de:o l':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: The men washed the gold out of the ground in a river, and they worked from morning until night.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n lavaient:v la:o terre:n dans:o la:o rivière:n pour:o en:o extraire:v l':o or:n ,:o et:o ils:o travaillaient:v du:o matin:n au:o soir:n .:o

sentences.en: Each man had a pan, and he shook it in the water until the gold lay at the bottom.
sentences.tgt: Chacun:o avait:v sa:o batée:n ,:o qu':o il:o secouait:v dans:o l':o eau:n jusqu':o à:o ce:o que:o l':o or:n se:o dépose:v au:o fond:n .:o

sentences.en: The men filled small bags with the gold, and each day they had more.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n remplissaient:v d':o or:n de:o petits:a sacs:n ,:o et:o chaque:o jour:n ils:o en:o avaient:v davantage:a .:o

sentences.en: They did not find the lost cabin, but they did not need it.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o ne:o trouvèrent:v pas:o la:o cabane:n perdue:a ,:o mais:o ils:o n':o en:o avaient:v plus:o besoin:n .:o

sentences.en: "We are rich," Pete said, "and we will not be poor again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o sommes:v riches:a ,:o dit:v Pete:o ,:o et:o nous:o ne:o serons:v plus:o jamais:o pauvres:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: At night the men sat by the fire and talked about the gold.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soir:n ,:o les:o hommes:n s':o asseyaient:v autour:o du:o feu:n et:o parlaient:v de:o l':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: "What will you do with the gold?" Hans asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Que:o feras:v -tu:o de:o ton:o or:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Hans:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will buy a farm," Pete said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o m':o achèterai:v une:o ferme:n ,:o »:o dit:v Pete:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will buy a boat," Hans said, "and I will go home."
sentences.tgt: «:o Moi:o ,:o je:o m':o achèterai:v un:o bateau:n ,:o dit:v Hans:o ,:o et:o je:o rentrerai:v au:o pays:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will stay here with Buck," Thornton said, "for I do not want to go home."
sentences.tgt: «:o Moi:o ,:o je:o resterai:v ici:a avec:o Buck:o ,:o dit:v Thornton:o ,:o car:o je:o n':o ai:v aucune:o envie:n de:o rentrer:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: The men worked all day, and Buck had nothing to do.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n travaillaient:v toute:o la:o journée:n ,:o et:o Buck:o n':o avait:v rien:o à:o faire:v .:o

sentences.en: He lay by the fire and watched the men, and he thought about the wild dogs.
sentences.tgt: Il:o restait:v couché:a près:a du:o feu:n à:o regarder:v les:o hommes:n ,:o et:o il:o songeait:v aux:o chiens:n sauvages:a .:o

sentences.en: At night he dreamed again of the hairy man, and the dream was clearer.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n ,:o il:o rêva:v de:o nouveau:a de:o l':o homme:n velu:a ,:o et:o le:o rêve:n était:v plus:a net:a .:o

sentences.en: He heard a sound in the forest, and it was the sound of a call.
sentences.tgt: Il:o entendit:v dans:o la:o forêt:n un:o son:n ,:o et:o ce:o son:n était:v un:o appel:n .:o

sentences.en: After that night Buck heard the cry in the forest every night, and each time it was clearer.
sentences.tgt: Après:o cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o Buck:o entendit:v chaque:o nuit:n le:o hurlement:n dans:o la:o forêt:n ,:o et:o chaque:o fois:n plus:a net:a .:o

sentences.en: It was a long cry, and it was not the cry of a dog.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o long:a hurlement:n ,:o et:o ce:o n':o était:v pas:o celui:o d':o un:o chien:n .:o

sentences.en: One night Buck got up from the fire and walked into the trees.
sentences.tgt: Une:o nuit:n ,:o Buck:o quitta:v le:o feu:n et:o s':o enfonça:v sous:o les:o arbres:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton was asleep, and no man saw Buck go.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o dormait:v ,:o et:o personne:o ne:o vit:v Buck:o partir:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck went a long way through the forest, and he came to an open place among the trees.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o parcourut:v un:o long:a chemin:n à:o travers:o la:o forêt:n et:o déboucha:v dans:o une:o clairière:n .:o

sentences.en: A wolf sat there with his nose in the air, and he was thin and grey.
sentences.tgt: Un:o loup:n y:o était:v assis:a ,:o le:o museau:n en:o l':o air:n ,:o maigre:a et:o gris:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck came near him slowly, and he moved his tail to show that he was a friend.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o s':o approcha:v de:o lui:o lentement:a ,:o en:o remuant:v la:o queue:n pour:o montrer:v qu':o il:o venait:v en:o ami:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf did not want a friend, and he ran away.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n ne:o voulait:v pas:o d':o ami:n ,:o et:o il:o s':o enfuit:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran after him, and the wolf turned and showed his teeth.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o le:o poursuivit:v ,:o et:o le:o loup:n fit:v volte-face:n en:o montrant:v les:o crocs:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck stopped and did not growl, and he held his nose out to the wolf.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o s':o arrêta:v sans:o gronder:v et:o tendit:v le:o museau:n vers:o le:o loup:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf looked at him for a moment, and then the two of them touched noses.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n le:o considéra:v un:o moment:n ,:o puis:a ils:o se:o touchèrent:v le:o museau:n .:o

sentences.en: After that the wolf was friendly, and he ran on ahead through the trees.
sentences.tgt: Dès:o lors:a ,:o le:o loup:n se:o radoucit:v ,:o et:o il:o s':o élança:v en:o avant:a à:o travers:o les:o arbres:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran beside the wolf, and the two of them went a long way in the night.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o courait:v aux:o côtés:n du:o loup:n ,:o et:o tous:o deux:o firent:v un:o long:a chemin:n dans:o la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: They came to a stream, and both of them drank from it.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o arrivèrent:v à:o un:o ruisseau:n ,:o où:o ils:o burent:v tous:o deux:o .:o

sentences.en: The wolf looked back at Buck and cried, and he wanted Buck to come with him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n se:o retourna:v vers:o Buck:o et:o gémit:v ::o il:o voulait:v que:o Buck:o le:o suive:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck knew that the wolf was like him, and he was glad to have a friend in the forest.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o sentait:v que:o le:o loup:n était:v son:o semblable:n ,:o et:o il:o était:v heureux:a d':o avoir:v un:o ami:n dans:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: But he thought of Thornton, and he stopped.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o il:o pensa:v à:o Thornton:o ,:o et:o il:o s':o arrêta:v .:o

sentences.en: The wolf cried again, and Buck turned back toward the camp.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n gémit:v de:o nouveau:a ,:o et:o Buck:o rebroussa:v chemin:n vers:o le:o campement:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf ran beside him for a while, and then he sat down on the ground and cried at the sky.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n courut:v à:o ses:o côtés:n un:o moment:n ,:o puis:a il:o s':o assit:v par:o terre:n et:o hurla:v vers:o le:o ciel:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran on and did not look back, but he heard the cry behind him for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o poursuivit:v sa:o course:n sans:o se:o retourner:v ,:o mais:o il:o entendit:v longtemps:a le:o hurlement:n derrière:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: When he came to the camp, Thornton was awake, and he stood by the fire.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o il:o regagna:v le:o campement:n ,:o Thornton:o était:v réveillé:a ,:o debout:a près:a du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck jumped on him and licked his face, and Thornton laughed and shook him.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o lui:o sauta:v dessus:a et:o lui:o lécha:v le:o visage:n ,:o et:o Thornton:o le:o secoua:v en:o riant:v .:o

sentences.en: "You are a fool dog, Buck," Thornton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o n':o es:v qu':o un:o grand:a nigaud:n de:o chien:n ,:o Buck:o ,:o »:o dit:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck did not know the words, but he knew that Thornton was glad to see him.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o ne:o comprenait:v pas:o les:o mots:n ,:o mais:o il:o savait:v que:o Thornton:o était:v heureux:a de:o le:o revoir:v .:o

sentences.en: For two days Buck stayed in the camp and did not leave Thornton.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o deux:o jours:n ,:o Buck:o resta:v au:o campement:n sans:o quitter:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: But that night the cry came again, and Buck could not lie by the fire.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o le:o hurlement:n retentit:v de:o nouveau:a ,:o et:o Buck:o ne:o put:v rester:v couché:a près:a du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: He went into the forest and looked for the wolf, but he did not find him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o enfonça:v dans:o la:o forêt:n à:o la:o recherche:n du:o loup:n ,:o mais:o ne:o le:o trouva:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck slept among the trees, and in the morning he was hungry.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o dormit:v sous:o les:o arbres:n ,:o et:o au:o matin:n il:o avait:v faim:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton had always given him food, and now he must find his own.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v toujours:a Thornton:o qui:o l':o avait:v nourri:v ;:o désormais:a ,:o il:o lui:o fallait:v se:o débrouiller:v seul:a .:o

sentences.en: He stood still in a stream for a long time, and at last a fish came near.
sentences.tgt: Il:o resta:v longtemps:a sans:o bouger:v dans:o un:o ruisseau:n ,:o et:o enfin:a un:o poisson:n passa:v à:o sa:o portée:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck caught the fish in his mouth, and he ate it.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o happa:v le:o poisson:n et:o le:o dévora:v .:o

sentences.en: The next day he caught a rabbit, and the day after that he caught another.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n ,:o il:o attrapa:v un:o lièvre:n ,:o et:o le:o surlendemain:n un:o autre:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck learned to wait for a long time, and he learned to walk without a sound.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o apprit:v à:o attendre:v longtemps:a et:o à:o se:o déplacer:v sans:o un:o bruit:n .:o

sentences.en: He learned to hunt as the wolves hunted, and he was not afraid in the forest.
sentences.tgt: Il:o apprit:v à:o chasser:v à:o la:o manière:n des:o loups:n ,:o et:o la:o forêt:n ne:o lui:o faisait:v plus:o peur:n .:o

sentences.en: Each time he wanted to see Thornton, he went back to the camp and lay by the fire.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o fois:n qu':o il:o avait:v envie:n de:o voir:v Thornton:o ,:o il:o revenait:v au:o campement:n et:o se:o couchait:v près:a du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: "Where did you go, Buck?" Thornton asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o étais:v -tu:o passé:v ,:o Buck:o ?:o »:o demandait:v Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Do you love the forest more than you love me?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o aimes:v donc:o la:o forêt:n plus:a que:o moi:o ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Buck put his head on Thornton's knee, and Thornton laughed.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o posait:v la:o tête:n sur:o le:o genou:n de:o Thornton:o ,:o qui:o riait:v .:o

sentences.en: In the fall Hans and Pete took their gold, and they went home down the river.
sentences.tgt: À:o l':o automne:n ,:o Hans:o et:o Pete:o prirent:v leur:o or:n et:o redescendirent:v la:o rivière:n pour:o rentrer:v chez:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: "Come with us, John," Hans said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Viens:v avec:o nous:o ,:o John:o ,:o »:o dit:v Hans:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will stay here with Buck," Thornton said, "for there is more gold in this valley."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o reste:v ici:a avec:o Buck:o ,:o dit:v Thornton:o ,:o il:o y:o a:v encore:a de:o l':o or:n dans:o cette:o vallée:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Hans and Pete went away, and Thornton was left in the camp with Buck and Nig.
sentences.tgt: Hans:o et:o Pete:o partirent:v ,:o et:o Thornton:o resta:v seul:a au:o campement:n avec:o Buck:o et:o Nig:o .:o

sentences.en: Every night Thornton talked to Buck by the fire, and Buck lay still and looked at his face.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o soir:n ,:o au:o coin:n du:o feu:n ,:o Thornton:o parlait:v à:o Buck:o ,:o qui:o l':o écoutait:v sans:o bouger:v ,:o les:o yeux:n levés:a vers:o son:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck loved Thornton, and he stayed near him through the days.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o aimait:v Thornton:o et:o ne:o s':o éloignait:v pas:o de:o lui:o de:o la:o journée:n .:o

sentences.en: But each night the cry came from the forest, and each night Buck wanted to go.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o chaque:o nuit:n ,:o le:o hurlement:n montait:v de:o la:o forêt:n ,:o et:o chaque:o nuit:n Buck:o brûlait:v de:o partir:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck went to the trees, and each time he stayed away longer.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o partait:v sous:o les:o arbres:n ,:o et:o chaque:o fois:n son:o absence:n durait:v plus:a longtemps:a .:o

sentences.en: Thornton waited for him by the fire, and each time Buck came back.
sentences.tgt: Thornton:o l':o attendait:v près:a du:o feu:n ,:o et:o chaque:o fois:n Buck:o revenait:v .:o

sentences.en: Soon the first snow came, and a herd of moose came down from the hills.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a tomba:v la:o première:a neige:n ,:o et:o une:o harde:n d':o élans:n descendit:v des:o collines:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck stood among the trees and watched them.
sentences.tgt: Posté:a sous:o les:o arbres:n ,:o Buck:o les:o guettait:v .:o

sentences.en: In the middle of the herd there was a bull, and he had wide antlers.
sentences.tgt: Au:o milieu:n de:o la:o harde:n se:o trouvait:v un:o mâle:n aux:o larges:a bois:n .:o

sentences.en: The bull was taller than Buck, and he was old, and he was strong.
sentences.tgt: Le:o mâle:n était:v plus:a grand:a que:o Buck:o ,:o vieux:a et:o puissant:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck wanted to kill him, and he went after the herd.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o voulait:v le:o tuer:v ,:o et:o il:o se:o lança:v sur:o les:o traces:n de:o la:o harde:n .:o

sentences.en: The bull turned and looked at Buck, and his eyes were angry.
sentences.tgt: Le:o mâle:n se:o retourna:v et:o fixa:v Buck:o d':o un:o œil:n chargé:a de:o colère:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran at the herd again and again, and each time the bull came to meet him with his antlers.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o chargea:v la:o harde:n encore:a et:o encore:a ,:o et:o chaque:o fois:n le:o mâle:n lui:o faisait:v face:n ,:o les:o bois:n baissés:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck could not get past the bull, but he did not stop.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o ne:o parvenait:v pas:o à:o déborder:v le:o mâle:n ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o renonçait:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: At last the herd moved on, for the other moose did not want to wait, and the old bull was left alone with Buck.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a la:o harde:n reprit:v sa:o route:n ,:o car:o les:o autres:a élans:n ne:o voulaient:v pas:o attendre:v ,:o et:o le:o vieux:a mâle:n resta:v seul:a face:n à:o Buck:o .:o

sentences.en: For four days and four nights Buck stayed near the bull and did not let him rest.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o quatre:o jours:n et:o quatre:o nuits:n ,:o Buck:o ne:o lâcha:v pas:o le:o mâle:n et:o ne:o lui:o laissa:v aucun:o répit:n .:o

sentences.en: The bull could not eat, and he could not sleep, and he could not drink at the streams.
sentences.tgt: Le:o mâle:n ne:o pouvait:v ni:o manger:v ,:o ni:o dormir:v ,:o ni:o boire:v aux:o ruisseaux:n .:o

sentences.en: Every time he stopped, Buck ran at him, and the bull went on with his head down.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o fois:n qu':o il:o s':o arrêtait:v ,:o Buck:o fonçait:v sur:o lui:o ,:o et:o le:o mâle:n repartait:v ,:o tête:n basse:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck did not get tired, for he had grown strong in the forest.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o ne:o se:o lassait:v pas:o ,:o car:o la:o forêt:n l':o avait:v endurci:v .:o

sentences.en: The bull grew weaker every hour, and Buck knew that the end was near.
sentences.tgt: Le:o mâle:n faiblissait:v d':o heure:n en:o heure:n ,:o et:o Buck:o savait:v que:o la:o fin:n était:v proche:a .:o

sentences.en: On the fourth day the bull stopped and stood still with his head down.
sentences.tgt: Le:o quatrième:a jour:n ,:o le:o mâle:n s':o arrêta:v et:o resta:v planté:a là:a ,:o la:o tête:n basse:a .:o

sentences.en: He was too weak to run, and he did not lift his antlers when Buck came.
sentences.tgt: Trop:a faible:a pour:o fuir:v ,:o il:o ne:o releva:v même:a pas:o ses:o bois:n à:o l':o approche:n de:o Buck:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck jumped at his throat, and the bull fell down on the ground and died.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o lui:o sauta:v à:o la:o gorge:n ,:o et:o le:o mâle:n s':o effondra:v et:o mourut:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck ate the meat, and he slept beside the bull for a day and a night.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o reput:v de:o sa:o chair:n et:o dormit:v un:o jour:n et:o une:o nuit:n auprès:o de:o sa:o proie:n .:o

sentences.en: When he woke, he thought of Thornton, and he wanted to go back to the camp.
sentences.tgt: À:o son:o réveil:n ,:o il:o pensa:v à:o Thornton:o et:o voulut:v regagner:v le:o campement:n .:o

sentences.en: He smelled something in the wind, and it was the smell of men, but not the smell of Thornton.
sentences.tgt: Il:o flaira:v quelque:o chose:n dans:o le:o vent:n ::o une:o odeur:n d':o hommes:n ,:o mais:o pas:o celle:o de:o Thornton:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck did not know why, but he knew that something was wrong.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o n':o aurait:v su:v dire:v pourquoi:o ,:o mais:o il:o savait:v que:o quelque:o chose:n n':o allait:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: He got up and ran toward the camp.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o leva:v et:o fila:v vers:o le:o campement:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran through the forest all that day, and he did not stop to rest.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o courut:v à:o travers:o la:o forêt:n toute:o la:o journée:n ,:o sans:o prendre:v le:o temps:n de:o se:o reposer:v .:o

sentences.en: Near the camp he came to a trail, and Nig lay dead on it.
sentences.tgt: Près:a du:o campement:n ,:o il:o tomba:v sur:o une:o piste:n où:o gisait:v le:o cadavre:n de:o Nig:o .:o

sentences.en: There was an arrow in Nig's side, and Buck knew that men had done it.
sentences.tgt: Une:o flèche:n était:v plantée:a dans:o son:o flanc:n ,:o et:o Buck:o comprit:v que:o c':o était:v l':o œuvre:n des:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: He went on slowly and came to the edge of the camp.
sentences.tgt: Il:o avança:v lentement:a jusqu':o à:o la:o lisière:n du:o campement:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton's tent was torn, and his things lay on the ground.
sentences.tgt: La:o tente:n de:o Thornton:o était:v déchirée:a ,:o et:o ses:o affaires:n jonchaient:v le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: Many men were dancing around the tent, and Buck had never seen them before.
sentences.tgt: Une:o foule:n d':o hommes:n que:o Buck:o n':o avait:v jamais:o vus:v dansaient:v autour:o de:o la:o tente:n .:o

sentences.en: They were Yeehats, and they had come to the camp while Buck was in the forest.
sentences.tgt: C':o étaient:v des:o Yeehats:o ,:o venus:v au:o campement:n pendant:o que:o Buck:o courait:v la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats shouted and laughed, and they did not see Buck in the trees.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o criaient:v et:o riaient:v ,:o sans:o voir:v Buck:o caché:a parmi:o les:o arbres:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck heard a roar, and it was his own voice.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o entendit:v un:o rugissement:n ::o c':o était:v sa:o propre:a voix:n .:o

sentences.en: He ran at the men with all his strength, and he jumped at the first of them.
sentences.tgt: Il:o fondit:v sur:o les:o hommes:n de:o toutes:o ses:o forces:n et:o se:o jeta:v sur:o le:o premier:a d':o entre:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: That man was the chief of the Yeehats, and Buck cut open his throat.
sentences.tgt: Cet:o homme:n était:v le:o chef:n des:o Yeehats:o ,:o et:o Buck:o lui:o ouvrit:v la:o gorge:n .:o

sentences.en: The chief fell down on the ground, and his blood ran out.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chef:n s':o effondra:v ,:o et:o son:o sang:n se:o répandit:v sur:o le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck did not stop, and he jumped at the next man and killed him too.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o ne:o s':o arrêta:v pas:o ::o il:o bondit:v sur:o l':o homme:n suivant:a et:o le:o tua:v à:o son:o tour:n .:o

sentences.en: A third man hit at him with a stick, but Buck was quicker, and that man fell down.
sentences.tgt: Un:o troisième:a homme:n voulut:v l':o assommer:v d':o un:o bâton:n ,:o mais:o Buck:o fut:v plus:a vif:a ,:o et:o l':o homme:n s':o écroula:v .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats shouted, and some of them shot arrows at Buck.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o hurlaient:v ,:o et:o certains:o décochèrent:v des:o flèches:n sur:o Buck:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck moved fast, and most of the arrows hit other men.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o déplaçait:v si:a vite:a que:o la:o plupart:n des:o flèches:n atteignirent:v d':o autres:a hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck remembered the man in the red sweater, but he was not afraid of men now.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o souvint:v de:o l':o homme:n au:o chandail:n rouge:a ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o craignait:v plus:o les:o hommes:n ,:o à:o présent:n .:o

sentences.en: The law of the club said that a dog must not hurt a man, and Buck did not obey it.
sentences.tgt: La:o loi:n du:o gourdin:n disait:v qu':o un:o chien:n ne:o doit:v pas:o s':o en:o prendre:v à:o un:o homme:n ,:o et:o Buck:o n':o en:o tint:v aucun:o compte:n .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats were afraid, and they ran away into the forest.
sentences.tgt: Pris:a de:o peur:n ,:o les:o Yeehats:o s':o enfuirent:v dans:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran after them and killed more of them, and he did not stop until the forest was quiet.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o les:o poursuivit:v ,:o en:o tua:v d':o autres:o encore:a ,:o et:o ne:o s':o arrêta:v que:o lorsque:o la:o forêt:n redevint:v silencieuse:a .:o

sentences.en: He went back to the camp and looked for Thornton, but he did not see him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o revint:v au:o campement:n chercher:v Thornton:o ,:o mais:o ne:o le:o vit:v nulle:o part:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck smelled the ground among the torn things, and he found the trail of his master.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o flaira:v le:o sol:n parmi:o les:o affaires:n en:o lambeaux:n ,:o et:o il:o trouva:v la:o piste:n de:o son:o maître:n .:o

sentences.en: Thornton's trail went down from the camp to a deep pool, and it did not come back.
sentences.tgt: La:o piste:n de:o Thornton:o descendait:v du:o campement:n jusqu':o à:o une:o mare:n profonde:a ,:o et:o ne:o revenait:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck stood at the edge of the pool, and the water was dark.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o tenait:v au:o bord:n de:o la:o mare:n ,:o dont:o l':o eau:n était:v noire:a .:o

sentences.en: He smelled the ground for a long time, and he found the marks of many feet.
sentences.tgt: Il:o flaira:v longtemps:a le:o sol:n et:o y:o trouva:v les:o empreintes:n de:o nombreux:a pieds:n .:o

sentences.en: At last he put his nose to the water, and he knew what had happened.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a ,:o il:o approcha:v le:o museau:n de:o l':o eau:n ,:o et:o il:o comprit:v ce:o qui:o s':o était:v passé:v .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats had killed Thornton, and he was in the pool.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o avaient:v tué:v Thornton:o ,:o et:o il:o gisait:v au:o fond:n de:o la:o mare:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck lay down at the edge of the water, and he did not eat.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o coucha:v au:o bord:n de:o l':o eau:n et:o ne:o mangea:v rien:o .:o

sentences.en: All that day he lay there and looked at the pool, and no sound came from him.
sentences.tgt: Toute:o la:o journée:n ,:o il:o resta:v là:a ,:o les:o yeux:n fixés:a sur:o la:o mare:n ,:o sans:o qu':o aucun:o son:n ne:o sorte:v de:o sa:o gorge:n .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats did not come back to the camp, for they were afraid of him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o ne:o revinrent:v pas:o au:o campement:n ,:o car:o il:o leur:o faisait:v peur:n .:o

sentences.en: One arrow had cut his side, and the blood on it was dry, but he did not lick the wound.
sentences.tgt: Une:o flèche:n lui:o avait:v entaillé:v le:o flanc:n ,:o et:o le:o sang:n y:o avait:v séché:v ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o lécha:v pas:o la:o blessure:n .:o

sentences.en: In the night the moon came up over the trees, and the water was still.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o nuit:n ,:o la:o lune:n se:o leva:v au-dessus:o des:o arbres:n ,:o et:o l':o eau:n dormait:v .:o

sentences.en: Buck had loved Thornton more than any man, and now Thornton was dead.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o avait:v aimé:v Thornton:o plus:a qu':o aucun:o autre:a homme:n ,:o et:o maintenant:a Thornton:o était:v mort:a .:o

sentences.en: No man was left in the world for Buck, and no man could call him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o restait:v plus:o un:o seul:a homme:n au:o monde:n pour:o Buck:o ,:o et:o personne:o ne:o pourrait:v plus:o l':o appeler:v .:o

sentences.en: He remembered the farm and the Judge, and he remembered Perrault and Francois.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o souvint:v de:o la:o ferme:n et:o du:o juge:n ,:o et:o il:o se:o souvint:v de:o Perrault:o et:o de:o François:o .:o

sentences.en: He remembered Dave, and he remembered the club, and he remembered the cold.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o souvint:v de:o Dave:o ,:o du:o gourdin:n et:o du:o froid:n .:o

sentences.en: Those days were gone, and Buck was alone.
sentences.tgt: Ces:o jours-là:n étaient:v révolus:a ,:o et:o Buck:o était:v seul:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck had killed men that day, and he knew that no man could hurt him now.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o avait:v tué:v des:o hommes:n ce:o jour-là:n ,:o et:o il:o savait:v que:o désormais:a nul:o homme:n ne:o pourrait:v lui:o faire:v de:o mal:n .:o

sentences.en: A man with a club or an arrow was only a man, and a man could die.
sentences.tgt: Un:o homme:n armé:a d':o un:o gourdin:n ou:o d':o une:o flèche:n n':o était:v qu':o un:o homme:n ,:o et:o un:o homme:n ,:o cela:o pouvait:v mourir:v .:o

sentences.en: He got up and cried, and it was a long cry, and he cried it to the moon.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o leva:v et:o hurla:v ,:o d':o un:o long:a hurlement:n qu':o il:o adressa:v à:o la:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: It was the cry of a wolf, and it was the cry that he had heard in the forest.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v le:o hurlement:n d':o un:o loup:n ,:o celui:o qu':o il:o avait:v entendu:v dans:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: Far away in the hills another cry answered him, and then a third cry came.
sentences.tgt: Au:o loin:a ,:o dans:o les:o collines:n ,:o un:o autre:a hurlement:n lui:o répondit:v ,:o puis:a un:o troisième:a s':o éleva:v .:o

sentences.en: He lay down by the pool again and listened to the cries in the hills.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o recoucha:v près:a de:o la:o mare:n et:o écouta:v les:o hurlements:n qui:o montaient:v des:o collines:n .:o

sentences.en: The next night the wolves came down from the hills to the camp.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n suivante:a ,:o les:o loups:n descendirent:v des:o collines:n jusqu':o au:o campement:n .:o

sentences.en: They came out of the trees one by one, and there were many of them.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o sortirent:v d':o entre:o les:o arbres:n un:o à:o un:o ,:o et:o ils:o étaient:v nombreux:a .:o

sentences.en: They stood in a ring around Buck, and they did not make a sound.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o firent:v cercle:n autour:o de:o Buck:o ,:o sans:o faire:v aucun:o bruit:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck remembered Curly and the ring of dogs, and he stood still in the moon.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o se:o souvint:v de:o Curly:o et:o du:o cercle:n des:o chiens:n ,:o et:o il:o se:o tint:v coi:a sous:o la:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: He stood with his back to the pool, and no wolf could come at him from behind.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o était:v adossé:v à:o la:o mare:n ,:o si:a bien:a qu':o aucun:o loup:n ne:o pouvait:v le:o prendre:v à:o revers:n .:o

sentences.en: A big wolf ran at Buck, and Buck cut his neck, and the wolf fell.
sentences.tgt: Un:o grand:a loup:n fonça:v sur:o Buck:o ,:o qui:o lui:o ouvrit:v le:o cou:n ,:o et:o le:o loup:n s':o abattit:v .:o

sentences.en: Two more wolves came at him together, and Buck fought them as he had fought Spitz.
sentences.tgt: Deux:o autres:a loups:n l':o assaillirent:v à:o la:o fois:n ,:o et:o Buck:o se:o battit:v contre:o eux:o comme:o il:o s':o était:v battu:v contre:o Spitz:o .:o

sentences.en: He was quick, and he was clever, and he was strong from the forest.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v vif:a ,:o il:o était:v rusé:a ,:o et:o la:o forêt:n l':o avait:v rendu:v fort:a .:o

sentences.en: Three wolves lay dead on the ground, but the ring did not break.
sentences.tgt: Trois:o loups:n gisaient:v morts:a sur:o le:o sol:n ,:o mais:o le:o cercle:n ne:o se:o rompit:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: The wolves came again and again, and each time Buck fought them off.
sentences.tgt: Les:o loups:n revinrent:v à:o la:o charge:n encore:a et:o encore:a ,:o et:o chaque:o fois:n Buck:o les:o repoussa:v .:o

sentences.en: He was tired now, and blood ran from his neck and his legs.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v las:a à:o présent:n ,:o et:o le:o sang:n coulait:v de:o son:o cou:n et:o de:o ses:o pattes:n .:o

sentences.en: The whole pack came at him together, and Buck stood at the edge of the water and fought them.
sentences.tgt: La:o meute:n entière:a se:o rua:v sur:o lui:o d':o un:o seul:a coup:n ,:o et:o Buck:o ,:o au:o bord:n de:o l':o eau:n ,:o lui:o tint:v tête:n .:o

sentences.en: At last the wolves stopped and fell back, and they stood in the moon and looked at him.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a les:o loups:n cessèrent:v l':o attaque:n et:o reculèrent:v ,:o puis:a restèrent:v sous:o la:o lune:n à:o le:o regarder:v .:o

sentences.en: One wolf came out of the ring, and he was thin and grey.
sentences.tgt: Un:o loup:n sortit:v du:o cercle:n ,:o maigre:a et:o gris:a .:o

sentences.en: Buck knew him, for this was the wolf who had run with him in the forest.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o le:o reconnut:v ::o c':o était:v le:o loup:n qui:o avait:v couru:v avec:o lui:o dans:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf cried softly, and Buck touched noses with him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n gémit:v doucement:a ,:o et:o Buck:o lui:o toucha:v le:o museau:n .:o

sentences.en: An old wolf came next, and his face was cut in many places.
sentences.tgt: Un:o vieux:a loup:n s':o avança:v ensuite:a ,:o le:o museau:n couturé:a de:o cicatrices:n .:o

sentences.en: The old wolf sat down in the moon and lifted his nose to the sky and cried.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a loup:n s':o assit:v sous:o la:o lune:n ,:o leva:v le:o museau:n vers:o le:o ciel:n et:o hurla:v .:o

sentences.en: The other wolves sat down and cried too.
sentences.tgt: Les:o autres:a loups:n s':o assirent:v et:o hurlèrent:v à:o leur:o tour:n .:o

sentences.en: Buck sat down among them, and he lifted his nose to the sky and cried with them.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o s':o assit:v parmi:o eux:o ,:o leva:v le:o museau:n vers:o le:o ciel:n et:o hurla:v avec:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: It was the cry that he had cried at the pool, and now it came back to him from many voices.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v le:o hurlement:n qu':o il:o avait:v poussé:v près:a de:o la:o mare:n ,:o et:o à:o présent:n il:o lui:o revenait:v ,:o repris:a par:o une:o multitude:n de:o voix:n .:o

sentences.en: When the cry was over, the old wolf got up and ran into the forest.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o le:o hurlement:n se:o tut:v ,:o le:o vieux:a loup:n se:o leva:v et:o s':o élança:v dans:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: The pack ran behind him, and the thin wolf ran beside Buck.
sentences.tgt: La:o meute:n le:o suivit:v ,:o et:o le:o loup:n maigre:a courait:v aux:o côtés:n de:o Buck:o .:o

sentences.en: Buck ran with the pack through the trees, and he did not look back at the camp.
sentences.tgt: Buck:o courut:v avec:o la:o meute:n à:o travers:o les:o arbres:n ,:o sans:o un:o regard:n en:o arrière:n pour:o le:o campement:n .:o

sentences.en: Many years went by, and the Yeehats saw a change in the wolves of that country.
sentences.tgt: Bien:a des:o années:n passèrent:v ,:o et:o les:o Yeehats:o remarquèrent:v un:o changement:n chez:o les:o loups:n de:o la:o contrée:n .:o

sentences.en: Some of the wolves had brown on their heads and white on their chests, and they were bigger than the other wolves.
sentences.tgt: Certains:o loups:n avaient:v la:o tête:n tachée:a de:o brun:n et:o le:o poitrail:n marqué:a de:o blanc:n ,:o et:o ils:o étaient:v plus:a grands:a que:o les:o autres:o .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats told each other about a Ghost Dog who ran at the head of the pack.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o se:o racontaient:v l':o histoire:n d':o un:o Chien:o Fantôme:o qui:o courait:v en:o tête:n de:o la:o meute:n .:o

sentences.en: "The Ghost Dog is more clever than any man," they said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o Chien:o Fantôme:o est:v plus:a rusé:a qu':o aucun:o homme:n ,:o »:o disaient:v -ils:o .:o

sentences.en: "He steals from our camps in the winter, and he kills our dogs."
sentences.tgt: «:o L':o hiver:n ,:o il:o vient:v voler:v dans:o nos:o campements:n ,:o et:o il:o tue:v nos:o chiens:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He is not afraid of our knives, and he is not afraid of our arrows."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o ne:o craint:v ni:o nos:o couteaux:n ni:o nos:o flèches:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Some hunters went into the forest and did not come back.
sentences.tgt: Des:o chasseurs:n s':o enfoncèrent:v dans:o la:o forêt:n et:o n':o en:o revinrent:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: Other men found them in the snow, and their throats were cut.
sentences.tgt: D':o autres:a hommes:n les:o retrouvèrent:v dans:o la:o neige:n ,:o la:o gorge:n tranchée:a .:o

sentences.en: Around them were the marks of a wolf's feet, and the marks were bigger than the feet of any wolf.
sentences.tgt: Autour:o d':o eux:o se:o voyaient:v des:o empreintes:n de:o loup:n ,:o plus:a grandes:a que:o celles:o d':o aucun:o loup:n .:o

sentences.en: "That is the Ghost Dog," the Yeehats said, "and he is killing our men."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v le:o Chien:o Fantôme:o ,:o disaient:v les:o Yeehats:o ,:o et:o il:o tue:v nos:o hommes:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats did not go near the valley with the pool, for they said that the Ghost Dog lived there.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o n':o approchaient:v jamais:o de:o la:o vallée:n de:o la:o mare:n ,:o car:o le:o Chien:o Fantôme:o ,:o disaient:v -ils:o ,:o y:o vivait:v .:o

sentences.en: Every summer a wolf came to that valley, and no Yeehat ever saw him there.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o été:n ,:o un:o loup:n venait:v dans:o cette:o vallée:n ,:o et:o jamais:o aucun:o Yeehat:o ne:o l':o y:o aperçut:v .:o

sentences.en: He was a big wolf with a thick coat, and he came alone out of the forest.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o grand:a loup:n à:o l':o épaisse:a fourrure:n ,:o qui:o sortait:v seul:a de:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: He walked down to the pool and stood at the edge of the water.
sentences.tgt: Il:o descendait:v jusqu':o à:o la:o mare:n et:o s':o arrêtait:v au:o bord:n de:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: He stayed there for a long time, and he did not move.
sentences.tgt: Il:o restait:v là:a longtemps:a ,:o sans:o bouger:v .:o

sentences.en: He lifted his nose to the sky and cried a long cry, and it was a sad cry.
sentences.tgt: Il:o levait:v le:o museau:n vers:o le:o ciel:n et:o poussait:v un:o long:a hurlement:n ,:o un:o hurlement:n plein:a de:o tristesse:n .:o

sentences.en: When the cry was over, he turned and went back into the forest.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o le:o hurlement:n s':o était:v tu:v ,:o il:o faisait:v demi-tour:n et:o regagnait:v la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: In the winter the nights were long, and the wolves went out to hunt.
sentences.tgt: L':o hiver:n ,:o les:o nuits:n étaient:v longues:a ,:o et:o les:o loups:n partaient:v en:o chasse:n .:o

sentences.en: The Yeehats saw the big wolf run at the head of the pack in the moon.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Yeehats:o voyaient:v le:o grand:a loup:n courir:v en:o tête:n de:o la:o meute:n ,:o sous:o la:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: He ran faster than any of the other wolves.
sentences.tgt: Il:o courait:v plus:a vite:a que:o tous:o les:o autres:a loups:n .:o

sentences.en: He cried the cry of the pack, and the wolves cried it after him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o lançait:v le:o hurlement:n de:o la:o meute:n ,:o et:o les:o loups:n le:o reprenaient:v après:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: That wolf was Buck, who had once been a dog on a farm, and now he was the leader of the wolves.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o loup:n ,:o c':o était:v Buck:o ,:o autrefois:a simple:a chien:n de:o ferme:n ,:o devenu:v à:o présent:n le:o chef:n des:o loups:n .:o
